name: print-social-creators-academy-influencer-posts-with-emoji-stickers
title: Creators Academy influencer pack with smiley, lightning and heart stickers on black, violet and orange
whatItIs: Nine square posts on black, violet, orange and lilac with bold white headlines ('You can become an influencer!'), cut-out photos of young creators, yellow smileys, white lightning bolts, blue hearts, orange starbursts and repeating 'CREATORS' text patterns.
whatItMeans: Loud and Gen-Z; sticker-like emoji graphics speak the language of social media.
techniques: Repeat the brand word as a background pattern.
Use a big colour circle behind cut-outs.
Italicise the key word in caps.

vocabulary.definition: Emoji-like icons placed as if stuck on.
A word repeated as background texture.
